Container.Name: hivemind
Container.Overview: HiveMind lets several AI models work together: ask one question, local Ollama models and cloud models (OpenRouter free models, Groq, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, any OpenAI-compatible API) answer, review each other, and a judge model merges the best final answer. Live view of every model streaming, with tokens, speed, time and cost. Single container, SQLite in /data. Early version (council test page); the drag-and-drop canvas is coming.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: llm ai ollama council openai claude openrouter groq gemini multi-model judge

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, run history and generated secret.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Your Ollama server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. Added as the first provider on first start; change it later in the Providers tab.

Config.Name: COMFYUI_URL
Config.Description: Optional: your ComfyUI, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8188. Its checkpoints become local image models for Image blocks. Added once; manage it later in Settings.

Config.Name: SECURE_COOKIES
Config.Description: Set to true when you open HiveMind over HTTPS (e.g. behind Nginx Proxy Manager).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts stored API keys. Empty = generated once and stored in /data/secret.key.
